obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional source relation; candidate inner complement bound or ambiguous converse
obernants.assumptions: Domain: finite valid byte files, bounded IDs and successful allocation; an operation's arguments plus its initial filesystem and scheduler state are inputs. Observations include returns/errors and written bytes. No simultaneous writer, path traversal, malformed offsets or crash is assumed unless explicitly modeled. Source-derived conditional relation, not a proof of all Rust executions. Evidence: tests.md distinguishes executed probes from proposed oracles.
obernants.domain: Finite admitted calls and filesystem states; exact specialization in catalog
obernants.observation_scope: One call or finite publication trace
obernants.operator: U is finite sorted well-formed acyclic version stores x lookup outcomes. U minus R includes returning a later ancestor's payload bytes different from the nearer matching payload and latest ignoring a captured nonempty main. Candidate inner bound; payload equality cannot reveal lookup provenance. Probe builds conflicting records.

obernants.operator: For observed records r at (h,i), all chains with nearest matching dictionary entry pointing to r and every earlier dictionary omitting i are compatible. Arbitrary farther ancestors and unrelated IDs remain free. Empty records can be a genuine zero-length entry, not absence. Probe tests zero-length and inherited records.

obernants.operator: Miss traversal terminates on absent parent or '-' in a finite acyclic chain. A parent cycle with no match loops; no visited set/depth cap exists. Invalid dictionaries can return wrong misses because sorted IDs are assumed. Probe tests finite miss only; cycles intentionally not run.

obernants.operator: For V visited versions, cold bytes D and returned L bytes, records costs O(D + sum(log n_v) + V*m + L), m=versions row count due to linear parent search; warm calls avoid D. Cache retains all loaded dictionaries/handles without eviction. Oracle proposed: instrument file opens; no timing claim.
